messages:
Maria C.: FYI I opened PR #4123 that adds the v1->v2 deprecation notice and model-swap guidance. Need quick sanity check on snippets + a short note about embedding dims and alias fallbacks.

Alex K.: skimmed it. Two quick nits: 1) the TS example still uses the older sync `.generate(...)` shape, we should show `client.responses.create` for v2. 2) snippet uses `model: \"rwd-instruct-v1\"` — our docs prefer `model_id` in some places; let's be consistent.

Samir: I can push a tiny patch for the snippet changes. Do we want to show v1 and v2 side-by-side or put v1 under a \"Legacy\" collapse?

Maria C.: put v1 under a small \"Legacy (v1)\" callout. The main flow should be v2. Also add one-line migration note about embeddings: v1 embeddings are 1536d, v2 are 1024d — callers need to reindex or use an alias when available.

Li (runtime): Confirming alias is available in hosted as `embed-compat` for a limited time, but Dedicated/Private customers may not have that alias. Docs should strongly recommend explicit `model_id` for Dedicated/Private and mention contact support to enable alias.

Alex K.: docs-bot flagged a broken redirect for the old TS SDK link too — CI will fail until we update that redirect.

Samir: draft snippet I'm planning to add (TS):

```ts
// v2 responses example
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'rwd-chat-v2',
  input: 'Summarize the release notes',
})
console.log(res.output_text)
```

We should also include a tiny mapping note: older SDK returned `result[0].content[0].text` -> new `res.output_text` (or `res.output[0].content`).

Maria C.: perfect. Add a short mapping table and a migration checklist bullet: \"verify embedding dims and update vector DB configs / reindex if needed\". Also add a one-line callout: \"If you rely on alias-based fallbacks, test on your Dedicated/Private config.\"

Jek: :thumbsup: Also check the web CDN snippet — some examples still pin v1. We should add a temporary notice recommending a pinned major only for reproducible prod builds.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint failed on PR 4123 — broken-link at /docs/migrate/v1-to-v2#examples.

Maria C.: Samir / Alex can you pick up the broken link and the SDK param rename? I'll merge once CI is green.

Alex K.: I'll take the redirect/file fix and update the TS SDK anchor.

Samir: I'll push the snippet patch in ~15m and ping here when it's ready.

Li (runtime): Added a short note to the Dedicated migration playbook: \"contact support to request alias enablement in private clusters\" — we should link to that playbook from the migration guide.

Maria C.: thanks everyone. After merge I'll backfill a short release-note blurb and coordinate the announcement in #announcements. Keep any follow-ups in this thread so we have a single audit trail.
